clips.title: The story
paras: Maclure Vineyards is a sprawling agricultural estate in southern Elwynn Forest owned by the Maclure family. While known for producing grapes and wine for the kingdom of Stormwind, the farmstead is equally infamous for an ongoing, bitter feud with the neighboring Stonefield family.

Nestled in the lush hills of southern Elwynn Forest, the Maclure Vineyards should be a peaceful haven of winecraft and farming. Instead, everyday labor is overshadowed by a vicious, long-standing rivalry with the Stonefields just down the road. Accusations of theft and bad blood run deep between the households, keeping tempers flaring even as common troubles—like hungry prowling boars and encroaching kobolds—threaten both homesteads.
